basic_info.description: Top-floor studio condo is located in the heart of Mission Dolores. This 602 ft studio has a light-filled open floor plan and a spacious walk-in closet. Quietly facing the the inner courtyard, the unit is tucked away from the sounds of the city.  Amenities include laundry on the same floor, deeded parking and storage, gym, sauna, bike room, garden green belt, guest parking and onsite professional management. Located near lots of public transportation and Dolores Park, and the Castro, you will find world class restaurants, bars, coffee and shopping near you!  Tenant Occupied paying $2550 per month.
